title: Complete frontend rebuild with sleek marketplace UI

requirements.text: Redesign the entire frontend with a sleek, minimalist e-commerce aesthetic inspired by the uploaded reference images (image-10.png and image-11.png), featuring clean product cards, smooth navigation, elegant typography, generous white space, and a cohesive visual identity that works seamlessly on both mobile and desktop

quotes: sleek and smooth and BEAUTIFUL but not overwhelming, remaining exceptionally suer friendly
mobile and pc both one must not ditch the other

acceptanceCriteria: Mobile UI matches the clean card-based layout and navigation patterns from image-10.png
Desktop UI reflects the spacious, elegant layout style from image-11.png
Responsive design adapts smoothly between mobile and desktop breakpoints
Typography, spacing, and color choices create a premium, cohesive brand feel
All interactive elements have smooth transitions and hover states

requirements.text: Implement campus verification system supporting both .edu email verification and manual campus selection during onboarding, storing campus affiliation in user profiles

quotes: both we'll figure that out layturrrrrrr

acceptanceCriteria: Onboarding flow includes campus selection or email verification step
Backend validates .edu email domains
User profile stores verified campus affiliation
UI clearly indicates verification status

requirements.text: Enable sellers to upload multiple photos per listing (up to 5 images), manage pricing, mark items as sold, and control inventory status with an intuitive listing management interface

quotes: multiple photo uploads, pricing, sold status, inventory control

acceptanceCriteria: Listing creation supports uploading up to 5 photos
Sellers can reorder photos via drag-and-drop
Sold status can be toggled on listings
My Listings page shows inventory status clearly

requirements.text: Build advanced search and filtering UI with category-specific filters for campus needs including textbooks, furniture, electronics, clothing, dorm essentials, course materials, and move-out sales, with sort options and price ranges

quotes: Advanced search & filtering by category (textbooks, furniture, electronics, clothing, etc.)
Smart categorization with campus-specific needs (dorm essentials, course materials, move-out sales)

acceptanceCriteria: Search page includes category chips for all campus-specific categories
Filters support price range, condition, and campus location
Sort options include price, date posted, and relevance
Filter state persists across page navigation

requirements.text: Create comprehensive user profile pages displaying seller ratings, listing history, verification badges, campus affiliation, and trust indicators

quotes: User profiles with seller ratings and listing history

acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows user's active and sold listings
Seller rating displayed prominently with review count
Verification badges visible for verified users
Campus affiliation shown on profile

requirements.text: Implement buyer-seller messaging system with thread-based conversations, typing indicators, read receipts, and quick offer buttons for seamless communication
acceptanceCriteria: Users can initiate chat from listing detail pages
Chat interface shows typing indicators
Read receipts indicate when messages are seen
Quick offer button pre-fills common message templates

requirements.text: Add price suggestion feature that analyzes item condition, category, and comparable listings to recommend optimal pricing when creating or editing listings

quotes: Price suggestion based on item condition

acceptanceCriteria: Price suggestion appears during listing creation
Suggestions factor in condition (new, like new, good, fair)
Suggestions consider category-specific pricing patterns
Users can accept or override suggested prices

requirements.text: Implement urgent sale tags for end-of-semester listings, allowing sellers to mark listings as time-sensitive and prioritizing them in search results and feeds

quotes: Urgent sale tags for end-of-semester listings

acceptanceCriteria: Sellers can toggle 'Urgent Sale' flag on listings
Urgent sale badge displays prominently on listing cards
Urgent listings appear higher in search results
Feed algorithms prioritize urgent sale items

requirements.text: Add campus meetup location suggestions feature that recommends safe, public meeting spots on campus when buyers and sellers arrange transactions
acceptanceCriteria: Listing detail or chat UI suggests common campus meetup spots
Suggestions include library, student center, main quad, etc.
Users can select from suggested locations in chat
Safety tips accompany meetup suggestions

requirements.text: Implement saved searches feature allowing users to save search queries with filters and receive notifications when new listings match their saved criteria
acceptanceCriteria: Users can save current search query and filters
Saved searches accessible from user profile or search page
Backend checks new listings against saved searches
Notifications sent when matches are found

requirements.text: Redesign home page with a premium dashboard layout featuring personalized listing recommendations, quick action cards, recently viewed items strip, trending section, and campus-specific widgets, all styled with the new minimalist aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Home page uses card-based layout matching reference designs
Personalized recommendations section displays relevant listings
Quick actions provide shortcuts to key features
Recently viewed strip shows horizontal scrollable items
Design matches premium e-commerce aesthetic from uploaded images

requirements.text: Redesign listing detail pages with large image carousels, clear pricing and condition display, prominent save and cart actions, seller profile preview, chat button, and integrated safety tips, following the clean product detail layout from the reference images
acceptanceCriteria: Image carousel displays multiple photos with smooth navigation
Product details laid out cleanly with clear hierarchy
Save and cart buttons prominent and accessible
Seller profile card shows rating and verification status
Chat button easily accessible for buyer-seller communication
Safety tips banner integrated into layout

requirements.text: Redesign search results page with grid-based listing cards, elegant filtering UI, category browsing chips, and smooth transitions, maintaining the minimalist aesthetic across mobile and desktop
acceptanceCriteria: Listing cards arranged in responsive grid
Filter controls accessible and intuitive
Category chips allow quick category switching
Smooth animations on filter changes and loading states
Layout adapts elegantly between mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Create a visually cohesive design system with a carefully chosen color palette (avoiding blue and purple unless specified), elegant typography hierarchy, consistent spacing scale, and smooth micro-interactions that give the app a premium, polished feel
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette distinct from generic blue/purple schemes
Typography uses modern, readable font stack with clear hierarchy
Consistent spacing and border radius across components
Micro-interactions (hover states, transitions) feel polished
Design system applied consistently across all pages

constraints: Do not edit immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain single-actor Motoko architecture in backend/main.mo
Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and React Query for frontend
Authentication must use Internet Identity only
All images must be stored as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated, not routed through backend
nonGoals: Integration with external databases or cloud providers
Payment gateway integration beyond what's already supported

required: Clean minimalist hero banner for home page featuring campus theme with warm neutral tones (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
Campus marketplace logo icon with modern geometric design in warm earth tones (logo-icon.dim_256x256.png)
Placeholder product image for listings without photos, simple line art style (product-placeholder.dim_400x400.png)
Campus building silhouette illustration for onboarding background in muted colors (onboarding-bg.dim_800x600.png)
